new.analysis: The athlete missed all runs for the week that was reviewed.  They are a beginner with a 5‑K goal and we are in the build phase, so the focus is on keeping 80 % of the volume easy and inserting only one quality session that is not placed on a back‑to‑back hard day.  The plan re‑establishes the routine of Mon‑Wed‑Sat walk‑runs, uses the same 2‑min run/1‑min walk structure for the easy days, and adds a 3‑min run/1‑min walk interval on Saturday to elevate effort.  Rest days are kept true to allow recovery.  No red flags were seen in the week’s recap, so a conservative approach is appropriate.  The plan is presented in the required format, each line explains what to run and why.  Flags focus on rest compliance, quality effort, fatigue, and progression.  The headline captures the key intent of the week.
